The batch therefore emphasizes matched curves and amount contrasts around these failure regions rather than selecting only large predicted volumes.","batch_rationale":"The batch combines paired or sequential measurements for ethyl aminocrotonate, nitrobenzophenone, m159, m205, m161, m13, and aromatic ketones with targeted amount contrasts for m90, m119, m206, m193, m202, m199, and m160. These local experiments repair regions where recent labels exposed large or directionally inconsistent errors and teach response shape rather than isolated endpoint offsets. Several carbonyl and aliphatic controls test whether corrections transfer across topology, while high-retention nitrogen, charged, sulfur, and heteroatom-rich compounds cover structurally distinct failure regions that can affect many Row-distribution rows. The mix includes moderate-retention intermediates as well as broad high-volume cases, reducing redundancy while improving coverage of onset, completion, and interval-width behavior.
